Method of Attack: Buffer overflow weakness in GNU C Library's dynamic loader
Exploitation via maliciously crafted GLIBC_TUNABLES environment variable processed by ld.so dynamic loader
Arbitrary code execution with root privileges when launching binaries with SUID permission
Attack Vector: Malicious GLIBC_TUNABLES environment variable processed by ld.so dynamic loader
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept exploit code published on GitHub and elsewhere
